name: Hiraga Ai
source: Koumokuten of the Four Heavenly Kings. Maid of the Mahjong Banchou. An android built in 1778 for the purpose of playing Mahjong, her master has mastered Mahjong, which allowed him to overcome the technological limitations of the times. Capable of analyzing her opponents and storing their data for self-improvement.
